description: This Java source file defines the ExternalService entity for the Apache Fineract project. It represents an external service configuration, is mapped to the 'c_external_service' database table, and includes a static method to create an instance from a JsonCommand.

classes.name: ExternalService
classes.description: JPA entity representing an external service configuration with a unique name.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ExternalService instance from a JsonCommand by extracting the 'name' parameter.
